title: vra IAM action manifest (iam/actions/<workflow>.yaml; Lane C mirrors these)
description: Least-privilege action set a workflow needs, used for iam:SimulatePrincipalPolicy preflight and for IT-request policy generation. Partition-generic: resources use ${Partition}, ${Region}, ${Account}, ${CoreStack}, ${SsmPrefix}, ${LiveTestSecret}, ${ExternalTableKmsKey} placeholders resolved at runtime, and ${RegisteredBucket} / ${RegisteredBucketKmsKey} in forEach statements; never a literal commercial-partition ARN prefix.

role.description: which env role this manifest is simulated against

optional.description: a gap here warns rather than blocks

feature.description: simulated only when the env enables the feature (changeSetGate: diffGate changeset; maintenanceMode: writeFreeze backend maintenance-mode, optional for auto; externalTableKey: the overlay sets app.useKmsCmkEncryption.optionalExternalCmkArn, resources use ${ExternalTableKmsKey}; cognitoExport: env.yaml cognitoExport true; cloudFrontQuota: the overlay deploys on CloudFront, app.useCloudFront.enabled in the aws partition, optional without an overlay; reindexDirect: env.yaml reindex.mode direct, resources may use ${SsmRoot}, the SSM prefix without /resourceNames)

forEach.description: expanded at run time: one statement per bucket of the env (SSM s3Buckets/* + every registered asset bucket of s3AssetBucketsStorage; resources use ${RegisteredBucket}) or per distinct default-encryption KMS key of those buckets (resources use ${RegisteredBucketKmsKey}). Without a resolvable bucket list (dry run, stack not deployed) ${RegisteredBucket} falls back to ${CoreStack}* and key statements are not simulated.
